name: furnace
description: Buyback-and-burn engine on Hedera: a token team points HBAR revenue at FurnaceEngine, which creates the HTS token, locks its SaucerSwap V1 liquidity, and on its own Hedera Schedule Service schedule buys the token back inside a Chainlink-priced USD budget, a price ceiling and a price-impact cap, then burns it with the HTS supply key it holds.

steps.text: FurnaceEngine creates your HTS token, pairs it with WHBAR on SaucerSwap V1, buys it back on its own Hedera schedule and burns what it buys. Contracts run against Hedera testnet; there is no local chain step.

steps.label: Put its key in packages/foundry/.env as DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY, then run the whole loop on testnet: token, pool, burn, scheduled burn

steps.text: README.md walks through the design; AGENTS.md briefs coding agents.
